subject: Shiny-Server repaint issues with JS library

messages.author: 63343b7c1e9b5cbc
messages.subject: Shiny-Server repaint issues with JS library
parts:
Hi,

First off shiny is a really fantastic tool and much appreciated.

I'm running into some unusual repainting issues using a JS plotting library in conjunction with shiny server.

Specifically, using the package rChartsDygraphs,
https://github.com/danielkrizian/rChartsDygraphs
and the following code:
#ui.r
####
require(shiny);require(rCharts);require(rChartsDygraph)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel('Dygraphs Test in Shiny with rCharts'),
  mainPanel(
    chartOutput('mygraph', 'dygraph', package="rChartsDygraph", add_lib=T) 
  )
))
###
##server.r
require(rCharts);require(rChartsDygraph);require(shiny);require(quantmod)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session){
  getSymbols("SPY", from = "1993-01-01")
  SPY <- data.frame(Date=index(SPY), Price=SPY$SPY.Close)
  SPY$Momentum20days <- momentum(SPY$SPY.Close, 20)/lag(SPY$SPY.Close, 20)*100
  
  output$mygraph <- renderChart2({
    dygraph(data=SPY[,c("Date","SPY.Close")], width=800)
  })
})
###
on shiny-server v1.1.0.0 is causing repainting issues when one zooms into or pans the graph. 

Interestingly, if the app is run locally with runApp() or runGist() the same issues do not appear. 

Any thoughts on what is happening within shiny-server?

messages.author: 12faec87a150bdca
messages.subject: Re: Shiny-Server repaint issues with JS library
parts:
I'll copy/paste what I think might be the answer here.  Seems completely unrelated to Shiny.

Not at all what I thought. Error on my side comes in here. Somehow my Chrome was zoomed to 90%, and that caused the issue. When I CTRL+0 to return to 100% or manually overrode the scales with canvasScale=1 andhiddenScale=1, everything worked fine. I am not sure we need to change anything if this is the case. I guess we could consider skipping or modifying the canvasScale check. We might file an issue over at dygraphs.

Note: when I set zoom to something less than 100% in IE, I get the same issue.
